bukhari.text: إِنَّمَا الْأَعْمَالُ بِالنِّيَّاتِ، وَإِنَّمَا لِكُلِّ امْرِئٍ مَا نَوَى
bukhari.translation: Actions are judged by intentions, and every person will get what they intended.

bukhari.text: مَنْ كَانَ يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الْآخِرِ فَلْيَقُلْ خَيْرًا أَوْ لِيَصْمُتْ
bukhari.translation: Whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day, let him speak good or remain silent.

bukhari.text: لَا يُؤْمِنُ أَحَدُكُمْ حَتَّى يُحِبَّ لِأَخِيهِ مَا يُحِبُّ لِنَفْسِهِ
bukhari.translation: None of you truly believes until he loves for his brother what he loves for himself.

muslim.text: مَنْ سَلَكَ طَرِيقًا يَلْتَمِسُ فِيهِ عِلْمًا سَهَّلَ اللَّهُ لَهُ طَرِيقًا إِلَى الْجَنَّةِ
muslim.translation: Whoever follows a path in pursuit of knowledge, Allah will make the path to Paradise easy for him.

muslim.text: إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يَنْظُرُ إِلَى صُوَرِكُمْ وَأَمْوَالِكُمْ وَلَكِنْ يَنْظُرُ إِلَى قُلُوبِكُمْ وَأَعْمَالِكُمْ
muslim.translation: Indeed, Allah does not look at your appearance or wealth, but He looks at your hearts and deeds.

nawawi.text: مَا شَاءَ اللَّهُ كَانَ، وَمَا لَمْ يَشَأْ لَمْ يَكُنْ
nawawi.translation: Whatever Allah wills will happen, and whatever He does not will will not happen.
